bugs_or_flaws: Layer Indexing/Metric Bug: Layers 0, 2, 3 show exactly 0.0 relative change across ALL models (pretrained/random/a1). Layer 4 is mostly zero with noise only at dist=0. This 'on-off-on' pattern (L1 signal -> L2-4 dead zone -> L6+ signal) suggests a systematic bug in layer extraction or indexing, not physical propagation behavior. Specifically, if token override affects input embeddings, Layer 0 should show non-zero change; the fact it is zero implies `token_override` does not propagate to L0 activations in this pipeline or indices are misaligned.

Missing Baselines: Task requested 'token/bag/size baselines'. Script only runs pretrained/random/a1. No bag-of-tokens or size-matched controls were executed, leaving the claim about global mixing vs locality unverified against these specific null models.
